proof_points.claim: A European medical-device manufacturer's quality council validated the pilot results and moved to production rollout
proof_points.context: Quality council review preceded a scoped ISO 13485 production rollout.

decisions.summary: Proceed with an ISO 13485-scoped Inspectly production rollout at a European medical-device manufacturer's primary plant (incoming + in-process QC), go-live August 15, 2026
decisions.rationale: Pilot met all quality-council criteria (cycle time −52%, 3.1x defect catch, doc compliance 78%→96%); Analytos committed an IQ/OQ/PQ validation pack mapped to ISO 13485 clause 7.5.6 and contractual EU-only data residency; contingent on signed data-residency addendum. Client must not be named in marketing until a reference agreement is in place.

thread.subject: Inspectly pilot results + rollout scope
thread.summary: MedNova Devices' quality council confirmed pilot results at the Stuttgart plant and agreed to a scoped ISO 13485 production rollout, contingent on the CSV pack and EU-only data-residency addendum. Client asked not to be named in marketing yet.

messages.body:
Arjun,

Our quality council reviewed the 8-week pilot at the Stuttgart plant:

- Inspection cycle time down 52% across incoming and in-process QC.
- 3.1x more defects caught per audit vs. our paper process.
- First-pass documentation compliance up from 78% to 96%.

The council's remaining concern is software validation: we operate under ISO 13485 and need your CSV pack plus a data-residency commitment (EU-only processing) before any production rollout.

Lena

Lena,

Both are covered: our IQ/OQ/PQ validation pack maps to ISO 13485 clause 7.5.6, and we can pin all processing to our Frankfurt region. Maya (cc'd, Head of Product) confirms EU-only residency is contractual, not best-effort.

Proposal: production rollout scoped to incoming inspection and in-process QC at Stuttgart first, success criteria mirroring the pilot metrics, go-live August 15.

Arjun

Agreed. Decision from our side: proceed with the ISO 13485-scoped Inspectly rollout at the Stuttgart plant, incoming + in-process QC, go-live August 15, 2026, contingent on the signed data-residency addendum.

Please avoid naming us in any marketing material until the reference agreement is in place.

Lena
